item.description: ### Fixed - **Clicking a Codex session that's running in the Codex desktop app now opens that conversation.** It was always meant to — but it only worked once Perch had found and read the session's transcript on disk, which takes a moment after a session starts. Click before that and you got the project folder in Finder instead, with no hint why. Perch now works out where a Codex session is running the moment it first reports in, so the conversation opens from the first click. Sessions in a terminal are unaffected: they still jump to the terminal, as before.
